hooks.command: in=$(cat); case "$in" in *'git push'*|*'gh pr '*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/pr_guard.py" ] || exit 0; for p in python3 python; do "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))' 2>/dev/null && { printf '%s' "$in" | "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/pr_guard.py" --hook pre; exit $?; }; done; exit 0

in=$(cat); case "$in" in *'git push'*|*'gh pr '*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/pr_guard.py" ] || exit 0; for p in python3 python; do "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))' 2>/dev/null && { printf '%s' "$in" | "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/pr_guard.py" --hook post; exit $?; }; done; exit 0
